name: Do I need permits for a full bathroom renovation in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a full bathroom renovation in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most full bathroom renovations in the East Bay, including Berkeley, Oakland, and El Cerrito, require permits. This is particularly true if the project involves changes to plumbing, electrical, or structural elements. Obtaining the necessary permits ensures that the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. Frasheski Construction will assist with the permit application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most full bathroom renovations in the East Bay require permits, especially for plumbing, electrical, or structural changes, to comply with local codes.
